description: This file defines functions for fetching project names from a backend API using axios. It includes a primary function 'fetchProjectNameDirect' that attempts to retrieve a project's friendly name via a dedicated endpoint, with fallback to a base URL configuration. It also contains a deprecated method 'fetchProjectNameByProjectId' maintained for backward compatibility.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the project name via API client if available, otherwise via axios with fallback to base URL. Returns the project name or null if not found or an error occurs.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId(projectId)
methods.description: Deprecated function delegating to fetchProjectNameDirect for backward compatibility.
